svg.title: CodingChallenge architecture: modules, layers, DI wiring and runtime flows
svg.text: Gradle modules, the layers inside them, how DI connects them, and what talks to what at runtime
SwiftUI · built by Xcode, not Gradle
commonMain compiles for Android and iOS
Platform modules add the Ktor engine (OkHttp / Darwin) and the SQLDelight driver
No Gradle edge: reached over HTTP
android.library · compose · paparazzi · hilt → both features apply all four; :app applies hilt
The two features never depend on each other: :app's AppNavHost passes autocomplete's onItemClick to navigateToDetail.
The API key never crosses the boundary: the app only ever receives summary text over SSE. Release builds have no proxy URL, so the Explain card is hidden.
